findings.location: Statement, conclusion that k_x is Schwartz; Proof 1.1
findings.evidence: The item uses Schwartz regularity and seminorms without identifying the exact earlier definition or stating its content. The reachable published definition def-schwartz-space-and-its-seminorms defines S(R^n) by finiteness of every p_{alpha,beta}(f)=sup_x |x^alpha partial^beta f(x)|. The Gaussian derivative bounds establish this criterion, but the item should state or identify it explicitly.

The limit uses k_{x,1}^j(dg_x^{-1}v,v), but this notation is undefined in the item and its supplier. lem-equivariant-rescaled-heat-kernel-extension defines k_x^j(w) and the two-point rescaling as k_x^j(a-b). State the limit with k_x^j(dg_x^{-1}v-v), or define the two-point notation.

findings.location: Verification 1.1, where the de Rham index is applied
findings.evidence: def-equivariant-elliptic-complex-index defines the index for an elliptic complex, but the example does not verify ellipticity of the de Rham symbol complex. The omitted check is immediate: at nonzero xi its symbol is i xi wedge, with contraction by xi^sharp divided by the corresponding nonzero scalar as a contracting homotopy. Add the exactness check before applying [F1].
